reasoning.summary: The document is a 'CO-BRANDING AND ADVERTISING AGREEMENT' between I-ESCROW, INC. and 2THEMART.COM, INC., effective June 21, 1999. The agreement involves co-branding of a website, development of an information transfer mechanism, and advertising fees based on transaction inquiries. Key clauses include IP ownership (content remains with respective parties), license grants (non-exclusive, non-transferable), term/termination (1 year from Launch Date, auto-renewal), governing law (California), and audit rights. No specific monetary cap or minimum commitment is stated in the visible text.

entries.evidence: "one (1) year following the Launch Date... automatically renewed for another one (1) year"
"This Agreement will be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California without giving effect to conflict of laws principles."

"A party wishing to renew this Agreement shall give the other party notice thereof no less than thirty (30) days before the expiration of the term then in effect. In the event that either party does not give such notice, the term of this Agreement shall be automatically renewed for another one (1) year."

"2TheMart and its suppliers retain all rights, title and interest in and to all intellectual property rights embodied in or associated with the 2TheMart Content... i-Escrow and its suppliers retain all rights, title and interest in and to all intellectual property rights embodied in or associated with the i-Escrow Content"
"2TheMart hereby grants to i-Escrow a worldwide, non-exclusive right to use... 2TheMart Content... i-Escrow hereby grants to 2TheMart a worldwide, non-exclusive right to use... i-Escrow Content"

"i-Escrow hereby grants to 2TheMart a non-exclusive, nontransferable right to use the i-Escrow Marks... 2TheMart hereby grants to i-Escrow a non-exclusive, nontransferable right to use 2TheMart Marks"
"Once every twelve (12) months, 2TheMart through a CPA may inspect and audit such records to verify reports."
"If a majority of the equity securities of either 2TheMart or i-Escrow, Inc.... are acquired by another company during the term of this Agreement either company may terminate this Agreement..."
